title: Deployed AI Engineer
description:
About Arondite
Arondite enables organisations to wield autonomy, data and AI at scale. We equip operators with the foundational software to orchestrate their mix of platforms and capabilities, and then take mission\-critical decisions faster than their adversaries.


We exist to ensure the UK and its allies out\-think, out\-pace and out\-adapt those who seek to threaten our values and way of life. Our technology is designed for deployment in the world’s most austere environments, and is relied upon by the world’s most demanding operators. We deploy alongside them, bringing our technical expertise wherever it is needed.

**You will join Arondite at a pivotal moment in the company’s journey.** We are ambitious, building for the long\-term and backed by globally renowned investors including Index Ventures (Anthropic, Wiz, Figma, Revolut). Our company is being built by exceptional people; people who find high\-tempo and challenging work engaging and exciting, and who consistently deliver outsized impact. You will collaborate with other brilliant minds to solve some of the world’s hardest and most important problems.

**You will have ownership and autonomy from Day One.** There is no corporate ladder at Arondite. We hire the best people and give them extremely high levels of autonomy; the sky is the limit for an individual with the right ambition.


If you are motivated by our mission and if you want to be part of an outstanding team, then we want to hear from you.


About the role
Arondite is looking for Deployed AI Engineers to understand our customer's problems and implement solutions using AI. We want people who are excited about the opportunity to take ownership for building AI within a high\-performance, mission\-focused team.


You will be working with AI/ML models and deploying them within our software products, both running in the cloud and on edge devices in the field. The role will also encompass addressing the wider practicalities and challenges in implementing AI\-based systems, including obtaining training data, addressing ethical concerns and explaining model behaviours.


As an early member of the AI team at Arondite, you will be able to shape how we exploit the AI revolution, both as part of products and to accelerate our internal processes.


Your responsibilities will include:* Working with customers to identify and understand their problems
* Designing end\-to\-end AI solutions from the sensor to the user interface
* Training, evaluating, testing and productionising robust and performant deep learning models to solve real\-world challenges
* Collaborating with other engineers to integrate models into our enterprise software product and resource\-constrained hardware systems
* Inventing novel capabilities and optimising existing approaches whilst remaining aware of ethical implications of your engineering decisions
* Documenting and explaining your solutions to provide evidence of compliance with policies regarding the safe use of AI
* Building secure, robust solutions by adhering to coding standards throughout the development lifecycle

  

**Requirements** *Arondite aims to bring together individuals from diverse backgrounds and with different perspectives. We therefore don’t expect people to have experience across every area of the requirements. Please apply even if you only partially fulfil the following lists.*


You should have:* Masters degree (MSc, MEng, etc) in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics or a related engineering field
* 4 years of relevant experience researching and applying modern AI/ML in areas such as scene understanding, multi\-modal sensing, control and path planning, or vision\-language understanding.
* The ability to write clean and maintainable code in Python, Rust, C\+\+ or Java
* Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Tensorflow or JAX
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to document your work effectively and present it to relevant stakeholders and users
* A passion for identifying and implementing pragmatic solutions to hard problems using AI and conventional algorithms


Ideally, you would also have:* PhD in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or a related field
* Authored publications in top\-tier journals and conferences (e.g. CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICCV, ICRA, IROS, TPAMI)
* Experience working with MLOps infrastructure or deploying AI models to production, including the associated monitoring, testing and quality assurance
* An understanding of different sensor modalities, their trade\-offs, and relevant methods for processing their outputs to drive performance in challenging scenarios
* Created and optimised state\-of\-the\-art AI models for resource\-constrained hardware
* Experience with synthetic data generation or simulation, or collection and management of large real\-world datasets


Deployed work at Arondite
All 'deployed' roles at Arondite involve working closely with customers at their UK locations, and when they go abroad. This can mean being away from our office for between 1 and 4 days a week on a regular basis, or going abroad for up to 2 or 3 weeks every few months. As this is a big commitment, we endeavour to maintain flexibility in resourcing to support people's personal circumstances.


Right to Work
We require that all candidates have an existing Right to Work in the UK at the time of application.


Security clearance
We believe in working closely with defence customers. As a result, this role will require the individual to hold a clearance or be willing to undergo UK security vetting to Security Check (SC) or above. This normally requires having continuous residency in the UK for at least 5 years.


Office vs Hybrid working
We are focused on building a positive, collaborative engineering\-driven culture. We therefore believe in making the office a friendly, comfortable and fun place to be, and we try to work from the office where possible. Of course, there are times when it makes sense for you to work from home and that's OK. You may also need to travel to visit customers, depending on your role. But in general you should only apply to join Arondite if you're excited to come into the office and work in person by default.


Application process
Our interview process for this role is normally:

* CV submission with initial questions
* Introductory Teams call (30\-45 mins)
* In\-person technical interview (1\-2 hours)
* Final interview with one of Arondite’s Founders (30 mins)

  

**Benefits**  

* Highly competitive base salary
* Generous equity in EMI share options in a well\-funded and growing startup
* 7% employer pension contribution
* Free meals in the office every day
* Private health and dental insurance, with opt\-in cover for dependents
* Cycle to work scheme
* Relocation support
* Access to any resources, equipment and training that you need to do your job in a world\-class way

description:
**About VoxSmart**

The world's most regulated firms can't afford to get compliance wrong. VoxSmart exists to make sure they don't have to worry about it.

VX1 is the unified communications compliance and governance ecosystem for the world's most regulated firms. One platform. Every channel. Every workflow. We capture, monitor, reconstruct and archive every regulated communication – across voice, mobile, messaging, chat, email and collaboration – under a single data layer. Nothing missed. Nothing lost.

We turn the noise of a thousand alerts into one intelligent insight, so compliance teams act on what matters, ignore what doesn't, and can defend every decision. Our approach is simple: data led, AI enhanced, human controlled.

Built on 10\+ years of operator\-grade experience, we are trusted by some of the world's most demanding financial institutions across major global markets – Tier\-1 banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers and commodities firms across 45\+ geographies. And we are growing fast.

We are now building the operating infrastructure to match our ambition. That means embedding AI into the way we work – not as a feature, but as a foundation. We are looking for an AI Engineer to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**

**THE CONTEXT**

VoxSmart has developed a clear AI Operating Model: a blueprint for how the business runs at scale. The model is built on human\-AI collaboration – AI executing repeatable tasks while humans frame problems, direct work, orchestrate workflows, apply judgement and supervise outcomes. Processes are being redesigned as AI\-driven workflows. Teams are organising around outcomes rather than functions.

This is not a conceptual exercise. The model is in motion, and we need someone to help make it real.

**THE MANDATE**

* Map, design and automate workflows across the business – translating how teams work today into AI\-enabled processes that are faster, leaner and more repeatable.
* Build and deploy AI agents and automation that shift tasks across the maturity curve: from human\-only, to AI\-assisted, to AI\-supported, to AI\-led.
* Work closely with the Head of Business Enablement to identify where AI can remove friction, reduce manual effort and free people to focus on higher\-value work.
* Embed AI tooling where it has the clearest impact – and help the business build the habits to use it well.

**The Role**

This is an early\-career role for someone with genuine AI fluency and a practical mindset. You do not need years of experience. You need to understand how AI systems work, have a feel for where automation creates real value, and be comfortable moving between business context and technical execution.

You will sit within the Data function and report to the Head of Data, with a dotted line to the Head of Business Enablement. In practice, this means you will move across teams – understanding how people work, mapping their processes and building solutions that make those processes faster and smarter.

This is not a back\-office engineering role. You will work with real business problems, work closely with colleagues across every function, and see the impact of what you build. If you want to learn fast and have your work matter from day one, this is that opportunity.

**Responsibilities**

* Map workflows across the business – documenting how tasks currently flow, identifying bottlenecks, manual steps and automation opportunities.
* Design and build AI\-enabled workflows and automation pipelines, working with LLMs, AI agents and no\-code/low\-code tools where appropriate.
* Work with teams across VoxSmart to understand their day\-to\-day processes and translate those into structured, automated workflows.
* Prototype and test automation solutions rapidly – learning from what works, iterating quickly and being pragmatic about what to build versus buy.
* Support the rollout of AI tooling across the business, including helping colleagues understand and adopt new ways of working.
* Contribute to the development of VoxSmart's AI Operating Model in practice – tracking what's been automated, what's in progress and where the next opportunities are.
* Stay close to developments in AI tooling and agents, bringing relevant new capabilities to the team's attention and helping evaluate them.

**The right person will have…**

* AI fluency – a solid understanding of how large language models and AI agents work, what they are good at and where they fall short. You do not need to have built production AI systems; you do need to understand the technology well enough to use it practically.
* A workflow and process mindset – natural curiosity about how things work, a habit of looking for steps that could be faster or removed, and the ability to translate messy business processes into clean, structured logic.
* Comfort with automation tooling – experience with at least some of: prompt engineering, AI agent frameworks, workflow automation platforms (such as Make, n8n, Zapier or similar), APIs and scripting (Python or equivalent).
* Strong communication skills – the ability to talk to non\-technical colleagues, ask good questions, explain what you're building and why, and help people understand and trust the tools you put in front of them.
* A bias for action – you would rather build a rough prototype and learn from it than spend weeks planning. You move quickly, take feedback well and are not precious about your solutions.
* Collaborative by nature – this role sits at the intersection of Data and Business Enablement, which means working across the organisation constantly. You need to enjoy that.
* A degree or equivalent grounding in a relevant discipline – computer science, data science, AI, engineering or similar – or demonstrable practical experience that gives you the foundations to do the job.

**What We Offer**

* A role at the centre of VoxSmart's AI transformation – with real scope, real problems and the ability to see the impact of your work from the start.
* A dual reporting line that gives you both technical grounding (Head of Data) and business context (Head of Business Enablement) – an unusual combination that reflects how seriously we take AI enablement as a commercial function.
* Competitive salary in line with market rates for an early\-career AI engineer at a high\-growth technology company.
* A business with real institutional credibility – a decade of trust with the world's most demanding financial institutions, and a product that the market genuinely needs.

title: Salesforce AI Engineer
description:
**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


As a Salesforce AI Engineer, you'll design, build and ship AI features on the Salesforce platform for some of the world's leading organisations. Working across industries including Consumer Goods, Utilities, Automotive, Telecommunications, and Financial Services, you'll spend most of your time hands\-on, building autonomous agents, connecting large language models to enterprise data, and getting AI systems running reliably in production.
  

This is an engineering role, not a configuration one. As Salesforce grows into a serious AI platform, you'll be building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to create agents and AI\-driven features that hold up under real workloads.
  

The work varies a lot. One day you might be designing an agent's reasoning and actions in Agentforce, the next writing Apex to ground a model in Salesforce data, tuning prompts and retrieval so answers stay accurate, or setting up evaluation harnesses to catch problems before they reach users.


**Your role**
-------------


Partner with Salesforce Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, and AI Specialists to design and deliver innovative Salesforce and AI\-powered business solutions.
  

Leverage Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to develop intelligent experiences, autonomous agents, and AI\-augmented business processes.
  

Act as a Salesforce and AI subject matter expert within the Digital Customer Experience (DCX) practice, helping shape our next\-generation consulting capabilities and AI delivery methodologies.
  

Design and develop scalable Salesforce solutions using a combination of declarative and programmatic technologies including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, Platform Events, and APIs.


Build AI\-enabled solutions that combine customer, operational, and enterprise data to deliver personalised, predictive, and proactive business experiences.
  

Integrate Salesforce with enterprise systems using MuleSoft, APIs, Event\-Driven Architectures, and AppExchange solutions to create connected digital ecosystems.


Utilise AI\-assisted development tools and modern DevOps practices to accelerate delivery, increase quality, and improve developer productivity.
  

Contribute to continuous innovation by evaluating emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply them across client engagements.
  

Support Agile delivery teams and champion modern engineering practices using tools such as Gearset, Copado, Flosum, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

Engage directly with client stakeholders, helping them understand how AI, automation, and Salesforce technology can unlock measurable business value.


**Why You?**


You'll thrive at the intersection of technology, business consulting, and AI innovation.
  

Working alongside clients, you'll transform and develop ambitious business objectives into practical, scalable Salesforce solutions powered by automation, intelligence, and next\-generation AI capabilities. You'll be expected not only to solve today's challenges but to help clients prepare for an increasingly autonomous, AI\-driven future.


Whether you're designing Agentforce agents, building enterprise\-grade Salesforce applications, integrating Data Cloud, or advising executives on AI adoption, you'll become a trusted advisor capable of translating complex technology into meaningful business outcomes.


Most importantly, you'll help shape the future role of the Salesforce consultant—leveraging AI to move beyond configuration and development into strategic solution design, innovation, and business transformation.


**Your skill and experience**
-----------------------------


**Technical Expertise**
  

* Strong Salesforce technical experience across one or more core clouds including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industries Cloud, or Field Service.
* Hands\-on experience developing solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, APIs, and Salesforce integration patterns.
* Hands\-on experience building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder and Model Builder, including designing agent actions, writing and tuning prompts, and grounding models in Salesforce data.
* A working understanding of how large language models behave in practice: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, and how to reduce hallucination.
* Experience testing and evaluating AI features, for example building eval sets, measuring accuracy, and monitoring quality, cost and latency once live.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration approaches, including MuleSoft, event\-driven architectures, REST/SOAP APIs, and external system connectivity, including connecting to AI models hosted outside Salesforce.
* Experience building solutions for large\-scale environments supporting hundreds or thousands of Salesforce users.
* Nice to have: familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector search and embeddings, or Python for AI tooling.

**Consulting \& Delivery**
  

* Proven experience translating complex business requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience delivering solutions using Agile methodologies within cross\-functional teams of engineers, architects, and business stakeholders.
* The ability to explain technical and AI concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating with third\-party delivery partners and Salesforce ecosystem vendors.
* Solid grounding in DevOps and modern software engineering practices across the Salesforce delivery lifecycle.

**Certifications \& Continuous Learning**
  

* Salesforce Administrator
* Platform Developer I \& II
* JavaScript Developer I
* AI Specialist
* Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Consultant Certifications (Sales, Service, Experience, Field Service, etc.)
* Agentblazer Legend
  

  

A genuine appetite for learning, shown through certifications, Trailhead credentials, hands\-on Agentforce work, and keeping up with how AI capabilities are moving.


**The most successful engineers will combine:**


* Salesforce platform expertise
* Hands\-on Agentforce
* Data and integration knowledge
* Clear technical communication
* Automation\-first thinking
* Modern engineering and DevOps practices

  

  

As Salesforce grows into a serious enterprise AI platform, you'll be the one building the autonomous agents and intelligent features that make it real and setting the standard for how Salesforce AI Engineering is done.


**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


**Please opt in during the application process.**


**Your security clearance**
---------------------------


To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
  

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
  

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

**Make it real – what does it mean for you**
--------------------------------------------


**Flexibility to work your way**
  

You will be encouraged to have a positive work\-life balance. Our hybrid\-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day\-to\-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


**Your wellbeing**

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Capgemini. Make it real.


**Why you should consider Capgemini**

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.


**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. You will continuously evaluate, learn, and adopt relevant open source libraries and frameworks — such as those spanning agent orchestration, vector storage, model serving, and ML pipelines — selecting and applying the right ones for the problem at hand. Equally, you will configure, integrate, and operationalize third\-party AI technologies and platform services, understanding their capabilities and constraints deeply enough to make them work reliably within the context of a larger enterprise system. You will engineer components with enterprise\-grade qualities in mind, ensuring your work meets defined requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. You will write and maintain the technical artifacts that accompany your engineering work — including low\-level design documents, component specifications, and integration contracts — ensuring your work is well\-documented, testable, and handoff\-ready.  Experience deploying and fine\-tuning open\-weight models (like Llama 3 or Mistral) via frameworks like vLLM or Ollama to optimize token costs and privacy.

 As an
 **AI Graduate Scientist** 
 at FD Intelligence, you will design, develop, and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions that push the boundaries of automation and document intelligence. * **Research \& Development** 
 : Investigate and implement advanced AI/ML algorithms, focusing on document intelligence, information retrieval, and data processing automation.

* First\-class degree (or equivalent) in Mathematics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline.

* Ability to translate theoretical models into practical, deployable solutions.



**Desirable** 



* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of vector search, RAG pipelines, and document chunking strategies.
* Familiarity with anisotropic vector quantisation or advanced similarity search techniques.
* Experience deploying AI applications in enterprise environments.
* Interest in explainable AI and model interpretability.



**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work on transformative AI projects with real\-world impact.
* Collaborative, research\-driven culture that values both innovation and rigour.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge tools, techniques, and publications in AI/ML.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Clear career development path into senior research or engineering roles.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
*"At* Klipboard *we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."*


Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.


Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.


A hands\-on building role: taking AI features from idea to shipped, working software quickly, inside real products that real businesses depend on. You design prompts, manage context, integrate models, build evaluations and handle the plumbing and the polish – all of it.


Crucially, most of this work happens in established C\# .NET codebases, not greenfield projects. Klipboard's products have been earning their keep for years, and the job is landing modern AI capability inside them cleanly, without breaking what already works. Fast matters here, but fast with evidence – every AI feature needs evaluation behind it before customers see it. We would rather you shipped something measured and honest this sprint than something perfect next quarter.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Role Accountabilities**

* Build AI features quickly and properly – from prompts and context design through to full LLM integration in established C\# .NET codebases.
* Make them production\-grade – error handling, fallbacks, latency management, logging, monitoring and solid evaluation before anything reaches a customer.
* Stay sharp and share as you go – keeping up with a fast\-moving space and spreading knowledge through code, examples and conversation.
**Key Activities and Contributions**

* Design and build prompts, context strategies and LLM integrations for product features, in domains where a confidently wrong price, part match or stock answer is worse than no answer.
* Work primarily in C\# .NET, integrating AI capability into established codebases through clean service boundaries, sensible abstractions and respect for the code that is already there.
* Move fast on real deadlines – prototype in days, harden in weeks, and know the difference between a corner that can be cut and one that cannot.
* Build evaluation alongside the feature, not after it – test against real business cases, measure quality honestly, and let the numbers settle arguments.
* Handle the unglamorous parts well: error handling, fallbacks when a model misbehaves, latency, token cost, logging and monitoring.
* Work with the engineers who own each codebase, fitting in with their patterns and pipelines rather than parachuting in something nobody else can maintain.
* Keep up as models, tools and providers change, and choose pragmatically on quality, cost and latency rather than habit.
* Share what you learn with engineers around you through code, examples and conversation.
* Work with product managers, product owners and subject matter experts to understand the business problem properly, because the best prompt cannot rescue a misunderstood requirement.
**Systems, Tools and Technology**

* C\# .NET (primary development language)
* Large language model APIs across multiple providers
* AI coding tools: GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents
* Prompt engineering and context design patterns
* Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings (desirable)
* Evaluation frameworks and automated quality pipelines for AI outputs
**Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Solid production experience with C\# .NET, including working in established codebases you did not write, and shipping changes into them safely.
* Hands\-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, context engineering and structured outputs, in real work rather than tutorials.
* A track record of shipping quickly, with examples of taking something from idea to working software in weeks rather than quarters.
* Experience testing or evaluating LLM outputs in some structured way, and using the results to improve quality.
* Daily fluency with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents.
**Core Responsibilities and Contributions**

* Deliver AI features end\-to\-end: from requirement understanding through to shipped, evaluated product capability.
* Maintain production\-grade quality: error handling, fallbacks, latency management, logging and monitoring – an AI feature is production software, with extra ways to fail.
* Care about accuracy, safety and data handling – customers run their businesses on the answers our software gives them.
* Leave things better documented than you found them, so the next engineer can pick up your work without an archaeology project.
* Prototype fast, harden properly, and know the difference between a corner that can be cut and one that cannot.
**Customer Experience**

* Ensure AI features deliver accurate, trustworthy answers – a confidently wrong price, part match or stock answer is worse than no answer at all.
* Understand the business problem behind each feature, not just the technical solution.
* Work with product managers and subject matter experts to ensure AI capability genuinely serves customer needs.
**Key Outcomes and Activities**

* AI capability shipped into at least one established product with evaluation behind it within the first six months.
* Something built has gone from idea to customers in weeks, and held up in production.
* Evaluation results have changed at least one decision, including, ideally, killing something that was not good enough to ship.
* Engineers around you have picked up techniques from your work, even though teaching is not your primary job.
* You can explain the business problem behind each feature you have built, not just the technical solution.
**People, Collaboration \& Culture**

* Bias to action – would rather build the small version today and learn from it than plan the big version for a month.
* Honest about quality – measures, shows working, and does not ship something they would not stand behind.
* Respectful of existing code and the engineers who maintain it – established systems are established for a reason, and working well within them is a skill you are proud of.
* Curious about the trades Klipboard's customers work in, because domain detail is where the good prompts come from.
* Comfortable with change – the tools will look different in six months, and that suits you fine.
**Additional Responsibilities (as aligned to company job architecture)**

* Leave documentation in better shape than you found it so the next engineer can pick up your work without needing to ask.
* Contribute to shared knowledge and engineering standards as the team's AI practice matures.
**Key Relationships (Internal and external)**


Internal

* Product managers and product owners (requirement understanding and feature scoping)
* Engineering teams who own the established codebases you build into
* Subject matter experts in Klipboard's product verticals (distributive trades, rental, automotive)
* Senior Applied AI Engineer and R\&D engineering leadership

External

* LLM platform and tooling providers (as needed)
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Solid production experience with C\# .NET, including working in established codebases you did not write, and shipping changes into them safely.
* Hands\-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, context engineering and structured outputs, in real work rather than tutorials.
* A track record of shipping quickly, with examples of taking something from idea to working software in weeks rather than quarters.
* Experience testing or evaluating LLM outputs in some structured way, and using the results to improve quality.
* Daily fluency with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents.
**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* Retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, tool use, vector search or embeddings in production settings.
* Experience with LLM APIs across more than one provider, with a feel for their trade\-offs.
* Exposure to any of Klipboard's sectors: distributive trades, rental, retail, automotive aftermarket parts or garage management.
* Experience modernising or extending long\-lived systems, in .NET or elsewhere.
* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, test datasets or automated quality pipelines for AI outputs.
* Klipboard is embracing AI at pace across our products and ways of working. We’re looking for people who are curious about how AI can enhance productivity, decision\-making and customer outcomes, and who are open to learning and adapting as this space evolves.
**What Success in This Role Looks Like**

* AI capability shipped into at least one established product, with evaluation behind it, and the team that owns that codebase is happy to have you back.
* Something you built has gone from idea to customers in weeks, and held up in production.
* Your evaluation results have changed at least one decision, including, ideally, killing something that was not good enough to ship.
* Engineers around you have picked up techniques from your work, even though teaching is not your primary job.
* You can explain the business problem behind each feature you have built, not just the technical solution.
**Company Info**


You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

**Equal Opportunities**


As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.


If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.


Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!

*To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV’s from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

description:
**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


As a Salesforce AI Engineer, you'll design, build and ship AI features on the Salesforce platform for some of the world's leading organisations. Working across industries including Consumer Goods, Utilities, Automotive, Telecommunications, and Financial Services, you'll spend most of your time hands\-on, building autonomous agents, connecting large language models to enterprise data, and getting AI systems running reliably in production.
  

This is an engineering role, not a configuration one. As Salesforce grows into a serious AI platform, you'll be building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to create agents and AI\-driven features that hold up under real workloads.
  

The work varies a lot. One day you might be designing an agent's reasoning and actions in Agentforce, the next writing Apex to ground a model in Salesforce data, tuning prompts and retrieval so answers stay accurate, or setting up evaluation harnesses to catch problems before they reach users.


**Your role**
-------------


Partner with Salesforce Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, and AI Specialists to design and deliver innovative Salesforce and AI\-powered business solutions.
  

Leverage Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to develop intelligent experiences, autonomous agents, and AI\-augmented business processes.
  

Act as a Salesforce and AI subject matter expert within the Digital Customer Experience (DCX) practice, helping shape our next\-generation consulting capabilities and AI delivery methodologies.
  

Design and develop scalable Salesforce solutions using a combination of declarative and programmatic technologies including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, Platform Events, and APIs.


Build AI\-enabled solutions that combine customer, operational, and enterprise data to deliver personalised, predictive, and proactive business experiences.
  

Integrate Salesforce with enterprise systems using MuleSoft, APIs, Event\-Driven Architectures, and AppExchange solutions to create connected digital ecosystems.


Utilise AI\-assisted development tools and modern DevOps practices to accelerate delivery, increase quality, and improve developer productivity.
  

Contribute to continuous innovation by evaluating emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply them across client engagements.
  

Support Agile delivery teams and champion modern engineering practices using tools such as Gearset, Copado, Flosum, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

Engage directly with client stakeholders, helping them understand how AI, automation, and Salesforce technology can unlock measurable business value.


**Why You?**


You'll thrive at the intersection of technology, business consulting, and AI innovation.
  

Working alongside clients, you'll transform and develop ambitious business objectives into practical, scalable Salesforce solutions powered by automation, intelligence, and next\-generation AI capabilities. You'll be expected not only to solve today's challenges but to help clients prepare for an increasingly autonomous, AI\-driven future.


Whether you're designing Agentforce agents, building enterprise\-grade Salesforce applications, integrating Data Cloud, or advising executives on AI adoption, you'll become a trusted advisor capable of translating complex technology into meaningful business outcomes.


Most importantly, you'll help shape the future role of the Salesforce consultant—leveraging AI to move beyond configuration and development into strategic solution design, innovation, and business transformation.


**Your skill and experience**
-----------------------------


**Technical Expertise**
  

* Strong Salesforce technical experience across one or more core clouds including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industries Cloud, or Field Service.
* Hands\-on experience developing solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, APIs, and Salesforce integration patterns.
* Hands\-on experience building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder and Model Builder, including designing agent actions, writing and tuning prompts, and grounding models in Salesforce data.
* A working understanding of how large language models behave in practice: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, and how to reduce hallucination.
* Experience testing and evaluating AI features, for example building eval sets, measuring accuracy, and monitoring quality, cost and latency once live.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration approaches, including MuleSoft, event\-driven architectures, REST/SOAP APIs, and external system connectivity, including connecting to AI models hosted outside Salesforce.
* Experience building solutions for large\-scale environments supporting hundreds or thousands of Salesforce users.

 Research has consistently shown that one\-on\-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.
 



 We are building an AI tutoring system designed to emulate and eventually surpass the best human tutors. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real\-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners.
 **If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you.
 
 This role can be done remotely from anyone of the following; United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal OR UAE**

 At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data\-driven decision\-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. title: AI Software Engineer
description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."
   

  

 Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.
   

  

 Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.
   

  

 A hands\-on building role: taking AI features from idea to shipped, working software quickly, inside real products that real businesses depend on. You design prompts, manage context, integrate models, build evaluations and handle the plumbing and the polish – all of it.
   

  

 Crucially, most of this work happens in established C\# .NET codebases, not greenfield projects. Klipboard's products have been earning their keep for years, and the job is landing modern AI capability inside them cleanly, without breaking what already works. Fast matters here, but fast with evidence – every AI feature needs evaluation behind it before customers see it. We would rather you shipped something measured and honest this sprint than something perfect next quarter.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Role Accountabilities**
* Build AI features quickly and properly – from prompts and context design through to full LLM integration in established C\# .NET codebases.
* Make them production\-grade – error handling, fallbacks, latency management, logging, monitoring and solid evaluation before anything reaches a customer.
* Stay sharp and share as you go – keeping up with a fast\-moving space and spreading knowledge through code, examples and conversation.


**Key Activities and Contributions**
* Design and build prompts, context strategies and LLM integrations for product features, in domains where a confidently wrong price, part match or stock answer is worse than no answer.
* Work primarily in C\# .NET, integrating AI capability into established codebases through clean service boundaries, sensible abstractions and respect for the code that is already there.
* Move fast on real deadlines – prototype in days, harden in weeks, and know the difference between a corner that can be cut and one that cannot.
* Build evaluation alongside the feature, not after it – test against real business cases, measure quality honestly, and let the numbers settle arguments.
* Handle the unglamorous parts well: error handling, fallbacks when a model misbehaves, latency, token cost, logging and monitoring.
* Work with the engineers who own each codebase, fitting in with their patterns and pipelines rather than parachuting in something nobody else can maintain.
* Keep up as models, tools and providers change, and choose pragmatically on quality, cost and latency rather than habit.
* Share what you learn with engineers around you through code, examples and conversation.
* Work with product managers, product owners and subject matter experts to understand the business problem properly, because the best prompt cannot rescue a misunderstood requirement.


**Systems, Tools and Technology**
* C\# .NET (primary development language)
* Large language model APIs across multiple providers
* AI coding tools: GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents
* Prompt engineering and context design patterns
* Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings (desirable)
* Evaluation frameworks and automated quality pipelines for AI outputs


**Technical and Professional Expertise**
* Solid production experience with C\# .NET, including working in established codebases you did not write, and shipping changes into them safely.
* Hands\-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, context engineering and structured outputs, in real work rather than tutorials.
* A track record of shipping quickly, with examples of taking something from idea to working software in weeks rather than quarters.
* Experience testing or evaluating LLM outputs in some structured way, and using the results to improve quality.
* Daily fluency with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents.


**Core Responsibilities And Contributions**
* Deliver AI features end\-to\-end: from requirement understanding through to shipped, evaluated product capability.
* Maintain production\-grade quality: error handling, fallbacks, latency management, logging and monitoring – an AI feature is production software, with extra ways to fail.
* Care about accuracy, safety and data handling – customers run their businesses on the answers our software gives them.
* Leave things better documented than you found them, so the next engineer can pick up your work without an archaeology project.
* Prototype fast, harden properly, and know the difference between a corner that can be cut and one that cannot.


**Customer Experience**
* Ensure AI features deliver accurate, trustworthy answers – a confidently wrong price, part match or stock answer is worse than no answer at all.
* Understand the business problem behind each feature, not just the technical solution.
* Work with product managers and subject matter experts to ensure AI capability genuinely serves customer needs.


**Key Outcomes and Activities**
* AI capability shipped into at least one established product with evaluation behind it within the first six months.
* Something built has gone from idea to customers in weeks, and held up in production.
* Evaluation results have changed at least one decision, including, ideally, killing something that was not good enough to ship.
* Engineers around you have picked up techniques from your work, even though teaching is not your primary job.
* You can explain the business problem behind each feature you have built, not just the technical solution.


**People, Collaboration \& Culture**
* Bias to action – would rather build the small version today and learn from it than plan the big version for a month.
* Honest about quality – measures, shows working, and does not ship something they would not stand behind.
* Respectful of existing code and the engineers who maintain it – established systems are established for a reason, and working well within them is a skill you are proud of.
* Curious about the trades Klipboard's customers work in, because domain detail is where the good prompts come from.
* Comfortable with change – the tools will look different in six months, and that suits you fine.


**Additional Responsibilities (as Aligned To Company Job Architecture)**
* Leave documentation in better shape than you found it so the next engineer can pick up your work without needing to ask.
* Contribute to shared knowledge and engineering standards as the team's AI practice matures.


**Key Relationships (Internal and external)**
 Internal
   

  

* Product managers and product owners (requirement understanding and feature scoping)
* Engineering teams who own the established codebases you build into
* Subject matter experts in Klipboard's product verticals (distributive trades, rental, automotive)
* Senior Applied AI Engineer and R\&D engineering leadership


 External
   

  

* LLM platform and tooling providers (as needed)


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Solid production experience with C\# .NET, including working in established codebases you did not write, and shipping changes into them safely.
* Hands\-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, context engineering and structured outputs, in real work rather than tutorials.
* A track record of shipping quickly, with examples of taking something from idea to working software in weeks rather than quarters.
* Experience testing or evaluating LLM outputs in some structured way, and using the results to improve quality.
* Daily fluency with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents.


**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**
* Retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, tool use, vector search or embeddings in production settings.
* Experience with LLM APIs across more than one provider, with a feel for their trade\-offs.
* Exposure to any of Klipboard's sectors: distributive trades, rental, retail, automotive aftermarket parts or garage management.
* Experience modernising or extending long\-lived systems, in .NET or elsewhere.
* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, test datasets or automated quality pipelines for AI outputs.
* Klipboard is embracing AI at pace across our products and ways of working. We’re looking for people who are curious about how AI can enhance productivity, decision\-making and customer outcomes, and who are open to learning and adapting as this space evolves.


**What Success In This Role Looks Like**
* AI capability shipped into at least one established product, with evaluation behind it, and the team that owns that codebase is happy to have you back.
* Something you built has gone from idea to customers in weeks, and held up in production.
* Your evaluation results have changed at least one decision, including, ideally, killing something that was not good enough to ship.
* Engineers around you have picked up techniques from your work, even though teaching is not your primary job.
* You can explain the business problem behind each feature you have built, not just the technical solution.


**Company Info**
 You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.
   

  

 If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.
   

  

 Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV’s from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Job title: Associate Software Engineer**
**Working hours: This role is available on a part\-time, job\-share or full\-time basis.**
**Salary: Up to £35,000 plus an excellent benefits package**
**Location:** 
*Warminster, hybrid with 3 days in the office a week with flexible hours*
**Help shape the future of software delivery at Zurich Nova**
 Originally founded in 2023 as a high\-tech AI start\-up, we were recently acquired by Zurich with a clear mission: keep the best parts of start\-up culture alive within an arm’s\-length team focused on transformation and innovation, which culminated in the creation of Zurich Nova.
   

  

 We sit at the cutting edge of AI. When you come in each morning, you can expect someone to already be talking about a new model released overnight, a breakthrough paper from the previous evening, or a fresh way to apply AI to real operational challenges. Staying on top of the latest developments isn’t a nice\-to\-have it’s how we work.
   

  

 Our team brings together a wealth of experience in artificial intelligence, enterprise technology, cloud infrastructure and process optimisation. We’re here to bridge the gap between rapid AI innovation and practical business outcomes, turning new capabilities into solutions that genuinely improve efficiency, productivity and operational performance.
   

  

 To make that possible, we protect time for research and experimentation. Everyone in the team has guaranteed space for R\&D projects including exploring new models, testing emerging tools and working together to discover better ways of doing things. We’re building intuitive, often no\-code solutions that can be adopted quickly but are powered by genuinely advanced AI techniques such as Reinforcement Learning, Generative AI and collaborative AI agents.
   

  

 Today, Zurich Nova as Zurich’s high\-tech AI venture, we’re helping shape the future of AI\-driven process optimisation across the organisation. Joining this team means becoming part of an ongoing journey where curiosity, innovation and ambition are not just encouraged, but expected and where pushing the boundaries of what’s possible is part of the job description.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This role sits in Zurich Nova within Life, Health and Bank Distribution a growing part of Zurich, focused on using AI to create a more revolutionary approach to software delivery. You will work with emerging technologies, language models and engineering platforms, helping to translate ideas into real\-world software solutions. This will require more than technical ability. It will require judgement, patience, resilience, emotional intelligence and the ability to communicate clearly with both humans and AI systems.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Collaborate with technical and non\-technical colleagues to solve real business problems.
* Build, test and improve AI\-enabled software solutions.
* Work across layers of engineering, from product concept through to technical implementation.
* Use prompting, model interaction and software engineering skills to shape better outcomes.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical language.
* Help design new ways of working that use AI to improve software delivery.
* Explore how emerging technologies can be applied safely, effectively and commercially.
* Challenge assumptions and improve existing interfaces, workflows and systems.
* Bring a maker mindset, i.e. someone who enjoys building, refining and understanding how things fit together.
* Stay curious about the deeper layers of technology, including models, data, infrastructure and software architecture.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who combines strong technical foundations with curiosity, resilience and emotional intelligence. An exceptional builder and problem\-solver to join a team working at the edge of AI\-enabled software delivery. This is not a role for someone who simply wants to write code, move on and climb the next ladder. We are looking for someone who cares deeply about the product, the craft and the impact of what they are building.
   

  

 What matters most is that you have a strong foundation in engineering discipline, a curious mindset and a genuine appetite to understand how things work at a deeper level.
   

  

 You may be a great fit if you:
   

  

* Have a background in software engineering, computer science, physics, engineering, data science or a related discipline.
* Have achieved meaningful outcomes in engineering, coding, software delivery or technical product development.
* Understand the principles of good engineering and can explain technical concepts clearly.
* Are naturally curious and enjoy working out how systems, products and technologies fit together.
* Have a genuine interest in AI, emerging technology, software delivery and product development.
* Are articulate, thoughtful and able to communicate complex ideas in simple terms.
* Enjoy building things whether that is software, systems, products or physical projects.
* Are resilient and comfortable with ambiguity, experimentation and iteration.
* Have the emotional intelligence to work patiently with AI tools, prompts, models and people.
* Can handle challenge, feedback and setbacks without becoming overly frustrated.
* Care about the quality and usefulness of what you build, not just the technical solution.
* Have ambition, but are motivated by mastery, impact and contribution rather than title progression alone.


**The mindset we value**
 We're less interested in ticking every box today and more interested in finding someone with the curiosity, attitude and potential to grow. The people who thrive in this team tend to share the following qualities:
   

  

* A creator at heart – you enjoy building, experimenting and continuously improving the things around you.
* Naturally curious – you're driven to understand how technology works beneath the surface and aren't afraid to ask questions.
* Resilient and adaptable – you embrace challenges, learn from setbacks and stay focused when navigating uncertainty.
* A clear communicator – you can explain complex ideas in a way that is engaging, practical and easy to understand.
* Empathetic – you recognise the human side of technology and value collaboration, inclusion and user experience.
* Outcome\-focused – you care about delivering meaningful results and creating solutions that make a difference.
* Committed to growth – you're excited by emerging technologies and motivated to keep learning, developing and expanding your expertise.


**What we are not looking for** 
 :
   

  

 We're not looking for someone who simply points out why something won't work. We're looking for someone who can identify challenges, communicate them clearly and help shape practical solutions.
   

  

 You'll be naturally curious, collaborative and motivated by making things better. Rather than being tied to a single technology or discipline, you'll enjoy learning, experimenting and adapting as technology evolves.
   

  

 Most importantly, you'll be someone who wants to make a genuine impact, continuously develop your skills and grow through the value you create for others.

 Our culture here at Zurich Nova is different. We believe working together makes us stronger.

 This role suits a genuine maker: someone who is curious, resilient and articulate. Language, and how you use it, is key to how you interact with AI. title: AI-First Engineering Intern
description:
**About Us**
 Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500\+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
   

  

 For more information, visit xsolla.com.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 Xsolla is going all\-in on becoming an AI\-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building.
   

  

 You'll work on two things:
   

  

* Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone.


* Proof\-of\-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought.


 This isn't a shadow\-and\-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions.
   

  

**Who You'll Work With**
 You won't be isolated on an intern\-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production\-grade, customer\-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Partner and collaborate with senior engineers to identify where AI tooling and integrations can remove friction, and build the fix.
* Build applications and integrations on top of Xsolla's APIs and SDKs that show internal teams how to move faster using AI\-assisted development.
* Ship work that matters. What you build is expected to reach real users – whether that's an internal tool an engineering team adopts or a customer\-facing integration – not a throwaway exercise that gets shelved after your internship ends.
* Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working – not a novelty you reach for occasionally.
* Share what you build. We run weekly 30\-second lightning\-talk demos where everyone shows how they used AI to solve something that week – you'll be expected to bring something real.
* Work with minimal process. You'll get context, a problem, and a mentor – the rest is on you to figure out and build.
* Learn from and collaborate with both directions: senior engineers who'll mentor you on production\-grade practices, and fellow interns across markets you'll trade ideas and code with at the weekly demos.


**What We're Looking For**
**You build things because you want to, and that you already use AI to do it faster.**
* Genuine passion for building. You have side projects, hackathon entries, open\-source contributions, or something you shipped just because you were curious. You didn't need an assignment to make it happen.
* Real AI fluency. You've actually used tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar agentic coding tools to build something – not just asked ChatGPT to explain a concept. You should be able to explain how you used AI to get there and how you confirmed it actually worked – not someone who fires off a prompt and hopes for the best.
* Bias toward action. Given an ambiguous problem, you start building before you ask for a spec.
* Comfort with developing modern full\-stack solutions – we care more about how fast you learn than what you already know cold.
* Open to current undergraduate students, graduate students, and recent graduates of a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related program. If you're pursuing a graduate degree and don't mind taking on an internship\-level role to get hands\-on with AI, we want to hear from you.


**How To Apply**
 No take\-home assignments, no formal problem sets. We're evaluating proof of work, not your ability to complete an assigned exercise. Please include:
   

  

* A link to a GitHub profile, deployed project, or anything else you've built – the more recent and self\-directed, the better.


* A short answer (2\-3 sentences, or a 2\-minute video/Loom if you'd rather show than tell) to: “What's something hard you built recently, and why did you build it?”


 We're not grading for correctness or polish. We're looking for whether you have a real answer, and whether it's clear you actually did the work yourself (with AI as your tool, not your ghostwriter).
   

  

 Xsolla takes your privacy seriously and will not sell or externally distribute any personal data received during the hiring process. In accordance with applicable data protection laws, Xsolla is committed to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy.
   

  

 For any inquiries related to data privacy, please contact: \[email protected]
   

  

 Explore more opportunities at: https://xsolla.com/careers
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Native SW Engineer - Manager
description:
You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi\-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it.

  

As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements.

  

This sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and govern production\-grade agentic systems at enterprise scale: multi\-agent orchestration across complex environments, RAG pipelines, policy\-based routing, memory management, and programme\-level lifecycle observability
* Define RAG pipeline standards across engagements: establish chunking and embedding strategies, set quality benchmarks, and ensure metric\-backed tradeoff decisions are documented and transferable

 **Vollzeit** 




  





 Das ist zuerst eine Consulting\-Rolle mit Umsetzungsverantwortung – kein Software\-Engineering aus der Ferne. Du sitzt im Team unserer Kund:innen, nicht daneben. Du hörst zu, bevor du baust, und stellst die Fragen, die im Raum stehen, aber niemand ausspricht: Warum läuft dieser Prozess so? Wer braucht diesen Schritt wirklich? Was hier „immer schon so war", hinterfragst du – und dann räumst du auf und setzt es um.
 



  





 Analyse und Umsetzung liegen bei dir in einer Hand: Prozesse bei Kund:innen erfassen, verstehen, wo sie brechen oder bremsen, sie neu denken – und die Lösung danach selbst bauen.
 



  





 Das geht selten reibungslos, und genau das macht die Rolle aus. Wer Prozesse infrage stellt, bekommt Gegenwind – von Menschen, die am Status quo hängen, sich um ihre Rolle sorgen oder das Projekt aus anderen Gründen bremsen. Du liest diese Dynamik: Du setzt dich gegen die falschen Widerstände durch, ohne Beziehungen zu verbrennen, und überzeugst die richtigen Leute mit Substanz statt mit Autorität.
 



  





 Die technische Umsetzung – Integrationen, Datenpipelines und Agenten\-Workflows auf Basis unserer Plattform und Methodik – ist dabei dein Werkzeug, nicht dein Ausgangspunkt. Du arbeitest mit modernen LLM\-Stacks an Problemen, für die es noch keine fertige Blaupause gibt.
 



 Und du bist damit nie allein: Was du im Feld über Kund:innen, Widerstände und funktionierende Vorgehensweisen lernst, fließt zurück ins Team – als neue Skills, Patterns und wiederverwendbare Bausteine, von denen alle profitieren.
 



  





**Wen wir suchen** 



* **Technisch stark \& hands\-on:** 
 Du bringst 1\+ Jahr Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung oder im technischen Delivery mit und schreibst produktionsreifen Full\-Stack\-Code – mit Python, TypeScript/JavaScript oder vergleichbaren Stacks. Du gehst selbst in den Code, wenn Fortschritt oder Klarheit davon abhängen.
* **Agentisch \& KI\-nativ:** 
 Du hast Erfahrung mit – oder große Neugier auf – agentische, KI\-gestützte Entwicklung (Claude Code oder vergleichbare Tools). Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Skills, Patterns oder Harnesses, die über den einzelnen Kund:innen hinaus im ganzen Team genutzt werden.
* **Consulting im Kern:** 
 Du hast Lust auf direkten Kund:innenkontakt – du kannst zuhören, nachfragen und auch mal unbequeme Wahrheiten klar aussprechen. Du arbeitest eng mit Kund:innenteams zusammen, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und führst sie durch die Veränderung, die du anstößt. Klare Kommunikation mit Entwickler:innen, Produktteams und Stakeholdern ist für dich selbstverständlich.
* **Pragmatisch \& entscheidungsfreudig:** 
 Du hast komplexe Systeme in schnelllebigen, mehrdeutigen Umgebungen gescoped und geliefert. Du wägst Scope, Tempo und Qualität gegeneinander ab, erkennst Risiken früh und passt Pläne an, ohne langsamer zu werden.
* **Sprachlich versiert:** 
 Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Bei Kund:innen vor Ort zählt jedes Gespräch.



  





**Was du tun wirst** 



* **End\-to\-End\-Delivery:** 
 Du verantwortest die technische Umsetzung über mehrere Projekte hinweg – von Discovery und technischem Scoping über Systemdesign und Build bis zum produktiven Rollout. Erfolg misst du an echter Nutzung und messbarem Workflow\-Impact, nicht an Demos.
* **Hands\-on\-Entwicklung:** 
 Du baust Full\-Stack\-Systeme mit LLM\-Integration, die beim Kunden produktiv laufen. Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen, schreibst und reviewst Code und sorgst dafür, dass aus Prototypen stabile Systeme werden.
* **Embedded bei Kund:innen:** 
 Du bist Teil des Kund:innenteams vor Ort bzw. eng eingebunden – nicht externe:r Dienstleister:in am Rand, sondern jemand, dem man vertraut. Du verstehst die Domäne der Engineering\- und Fachteams, treibst die Adoption deiner Lösungen aktiv voran, räumst Blocker früh aus dem Weg und hältst alle Beteiligten im Takt.
* **Wissen skalieren:** 
 Du machst aus funktionierenden Mustern wiederverwendbare Tools, Playbooks und Bausteine – und teilst dein Feedback aus dem Feld, damit unsere Teams verstehen, wo Modelle und Lösungen stark sind und wo sie besser werden müssen.

* **Gratis Fahrrad oder Mobilitätszuschuss:**
